## `src/runtime/elements`

### MpRouterLinkElement

**Kind:** component

```typescript
export class MpRouterLinkElement extends HTMLElement
```

A neutral router link rendered as a normal, accessible anchor element.

### MpRouterOutletElement

**Kind:** component

```typescript
export class MpRouterOutletElement extends HTMLElement
```

Router outlet that mounts a route's neutral DOM view. Applications may pass a
`viewAdapter` to the router when views need a custom lifecycle; otherwise a
Node, string, or DOM factory in `route.component` is rendered directly.

## `src/runtime/router`

### createWebComponentsRouter

**Kind:** function

```typescript
function createWebComponentsRouter(options: MpWebComponentsRouterOptions<View>): MpWebComponentsRouter<View>
```

Create the complete framework-free router runtime. Route matching and URL
resolution remain delegated to `@mission-platform/router`; this class owns
history, guards, redirects, subscriptions, and browser scroll behavior.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| options | MpWebComponentsRouterOptions<View> |  |
